text:
Plate spans about 400 px, which I take as a ~26 cm dinner plate, so roughly 0.065 cm per px... that gives about 15 px per cm.

The omelette is about 110 px wide and 220 px long, so about 7 x 14 cm. Its height is about 2.5 cm. That gives a volume of roughly 7 x 14 x 2.5 x 0.7 ≈ 170 cm³, or about 170 g.

The two small tan items look like roasted potato wedges or sweet potato pieces. Each is about 6 cm x 2 cm x 1.5 cm, so about 15 g each, or 30–40 g together. They could also be ginger or turmeric root.

The orange sliver is a carrot or pepper piece, about 5 g. A small red fleck in the omelette is pepper and too small to count separately.
